text: audit trail: server emits no security-relevant log events

Done in fe527d5. New shoppinglist_server/audit.py emitting on logger 'shoppinglist_server.audit'; the blueprint only emits, never configures handlers. Denials are logged centrally from _handle_api_error (every 401/403 in one place) and successes at their route. No addresses and no credentials: accounts are opaque ids, and forbidden keys are redacted rather than raising, so a future call site cannot break a request by logging wrongly. record() never raises. Verified end-to-end against a full session, not just unit tests. ProxyFix caveat for the ip field documented in server/README.md.
